art_direction_definition.center_of_appeal: the primary visual reason the image should hold attention
art_direction_definition.viewer_or_environment_relationship: how the subject relates to the viewer, another subject, and the surrounding space
art_direction_definition.composition_and_visual_hierarchy: the framing, depth, focal order, silhouette, and distribution of visual weight
art_direction_definition.medium_family: one deliberate rendering medium selected for the image
art_direction_definition.shape_and_rhythm: the major masses, directional accents, repetitions, and negative spaces that organize the design
art_direction_definition.surface_and_tactility: the material behavior of anatomy, covering, clothing, objects, and environment
art_direction_definition.color_and_light: a coherent local-color hierarchy joined to one lighting idea
art_direction_definition.detail_hierarchy: the planned concentration of edge precision, texture, and finish

notes: The default pack supplies a compact starting vocabulary; the agent remains responsible for semantic interpretation and art direction.
Scene-conditioned presentation may change while permanent identity traits remain stable.
Preset IDs are inspection handles, not required user vocabulary.
